(i) the addition of the FC and spectral clustering modules to the autoencoder-based deep SC network enables the joint learning of SE representation and clustering quality, (ii) the $S^2$ ConvSCN is robust against data corruptions of different types and origin, and (iii) it is the best-performing SC method on the benchmark datasets.

the proposed $S^2$-ConvSCN is the first deep SC network that jointly learns self-representation and handles data corrupions of unknown origin, while estimating clustering error using the unsupervised internal clustering validation method.

(a) the proposed $S^2$ ConvSCN is a deep SC network with a fully convolutional architecture that is based on a robust self-supervised loss function; (b) the proposed $ S^2$Conv SCN jointly learns SE feature representations and estimates the clustering error using the proposed internal clustering validation method without the use of external clustering validation methods and GT labels.
